name: Crispy Shrimp Burrito (Chimichanga) with Tomatoes, Cilantro & Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
6 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; place in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic; peel and small dice onions. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, jalapeño, garlic, and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheddar; cut cream cheese into small pieces. Place cheeses in the reserved bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (227 g) block cheddar cheese
¾ (227 g) block cream cheese

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Add shrimp, half of the cilantro (reserve remaining cilantro for garnish), and spices to the pot; cook, stirring often, until shrimp are opaque, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Reduce heat to low and add the cheeses. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cheeses melt and combine, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide shrimp filling down the center of each one. Fold in sides of tortillas and roll tightly to complete.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, lay burritos, seam-side down, and cook, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Remove from heat.
To serve, cut burritos in half and divide between plates. Top with tomatoes, reserved cilantro, and yogurt. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
